The README's import block lists the three names and a paragraph says what the face is for. This is the widening the `yes (widening)` line declares. Right.
- `RecordPointerCellProps.pointer` is typed `RecordPointer`, which the package does not export; a consumer passes an object literal `{ objectName, recordId }` (as `AuditLogPage.tsx` does) and the type checks structurally. Nit, no effect on correctness.

Right.
- Served metadata, API and i18n packs: unchanged (`grid.recordUnavailable` is the module's existing safe-translation default). `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

`patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`. An added export on a pre-existing package is additive; the lane's changesets carry `patch` for widening in this release line, and `Check Changeset` concluded `success` on this head. Correct.

- `open_questions`: one (item 3, unreadable rows): A, keep the shared face (`OBJECT · record unavailable`, id in the tooltip). Answered A by the seat: one rendering for deleted and not-visible rows keeps the resolver's no-oracle rule.
- Deviations accepted: item 4 left on the card (`Part of #33864`; the palette title is the server `searchAll` title, carried on #34055); the shared face instead of the bare id; the export from `plugin-grid`; module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` in edited suites.
- Forced test edits (CI round on `5f4c47f5`): `useObjectFields.draftOverlay-11895` finds options by the label-first accessible name and asserts each spelling with exact `toContain`; `openPathObjectReaders-12811` gains one `byName` row. Both legitimate: they move with the behaviour the card asks for, and neither loosens an assertion.
- `out_of_scope_findings`: Marketplace `SuggestedBindingsPanel` → #34094; palette record-share title → #34055; `ConditionBuilder` mounts with `labelSubjects` off → #34122.
- `security_findings`: none. Agreed: `RecordPointerCell` reads through the caller's data source and the permission check it already applies in the grid.
